inventory.name: Profiler interface ([Exposed=(Window, Worker)], inherits EventTarget; sampling profiling session bound to the constructing global)
new Profiler(ProfilerInitOptions options) — starts sampling immediately; RangeError if sampleInterval < 0; NotAllowedError DOMException when the js-profiling Document Policy disallows profiling
Profiler.sampleInterval — readonly DOMHighResTimeStamp, the session's effective sampling interval (UA may round the requested value up)
Profiler.stopped — readonly boolean, whether the profiling session has stopped
Profiler.stop() -> Promise<ProfilerTrace> — stops sampling and resolves with the collected trace
samplebufferfull event — fired at the Profiler when collected samples reach maxBufferSize; the session moves to stopped
ProfilerInitOptions dictionary — required sampleInterval (DOMHighResTimeStamp) + required maxBufferSize (unsigned long)

ProfilerTrace output family — ProfilerTrace {resources, frames, stacks, samples}, ProfilerFrame {name, resourceId?, line?, column?}, ProfilerStack {parentId?, frameId}, ProfilerSample {timestamp, stackId?}, ProfilerResource (DOMString)

Dedicated-worker exposure (the Chrome 147 change): Profiler usable inside DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope behind ProfilerAPIForDedicatedWorker, still gated by the js-profiling Document Policy; spec IDL already exposes (Window, Worker)

inputs.rationale: The interface is instantiated only through its constructor, whose parameters are documented under #constructor; it takes no inputs of its own (WICG IDL, fetched 2026-08-16).

outputs.rationale: Interface-level outputs are its members' values, each documented under #members (attributes, stop() promise) per the WICG IDL (fetched 2026-08-16).

errors.rationale: The spec defines exceptions only on construction (RangeError, NotAllowedError), documented under #constructor; no other member throws in the processing model (WICG draft, fetched 2026-08-16).

inputs.rationale: Readonly attribute: no writable inputs; the requested interval is supplied via ProfilerInitOptions at construction (WICG IDL, fetched 2026-08-16).

errors.rationale: Reading a readonly DOMHighResTimeStamp attribute cannot throw per the WICG IDL and processing model (fetched 2026-08-16).

securityPrivacy.rationale: Exposes only the session's own sampling interval, already supplied by the caller; no cross-origin or ambient data (WICG draft, fetched 2026-08-16).

inputs.rationale: Readonly boolean attribute: no inputs; state is driven by stop() and the samplebufferfull transition (WICG IDL, fetched 2026-08-16).

errors.rationale: Reading a readonly boolean attribute cannot throw per the WICG IDL (fetched 2026-08-16).

securityPrivacy.rationale: A boolean about the caller's own session state; exposes no data beyond what the caller controls (WICG draft, fetched 2026-08-16).

inputs.rationale: stop() takes no arguments per the WICG IDL (fetched 2026-08-16).

errors.rationale: The stop() steps define no rejection path in the processing model; the promise resolves with the trace once sampling ceases (WICG draft, fetched 2026-08-16).

inputs.rationale: A plain Event fired by the UA; listeners receive no event-specific payload per the WICG processing model (fetched 2026-08-16).

errors.rationale: Event dispatch defines no error surface; the transition it signals (session stopped) is documented in the same row (WICG draft, fetched 2026-08-16).

securityPrivacy.rationale: Signals only that the caller's own buffer limit was reached; no additional data exposure (WICG draft, fetched 2026-08-16).

outputs.rationale: WebIDL dictionaries are pure input values; nothing is returned through them (WICG IDL, fetched 2026-08-16).

context.rationale: Dictionaries carry no exposure of their own; usable wherever the Profiler constructor is exposed (Window, Worker) per the WICG IDL (fetched 2026-08-16).

lifecycle.rationale: Both members are required per-call values consumed at construction; the dictionary holds no state (WICG IDL, fetched 2026-08-16).

securityPrivacy.rationale: Caller-supplied tuning values only; the privacy-relevant gate is the js-profiling Document Policy documented with the constructor (WICG draft, fetched 2026-08-16).

inputs.rationale: Output-only data shapes returned by stop(); scripts never construct them as inputs (WICG IDL, fetched 2026-08-16).

errors.rationale: Plain dictionary data with no algorithms of its own; no error surface (WICG IDL, fetched 2026-08-16).

context.rationale: Dictionaries carry no exposure; they are delivered wherever stop() resolves (Window, Worker) per the WICG IDL (fetched 2026-08-16).

inputs.rationale: An exposure/capability change, not a callable: it has no parameters; enabling is via the flag and Document Policy documented in the same table (chromestatus + runtime_enabled_features, fetched 2026-08-16).

outputs.rationale: No return values of its own; it makes the Profiler members (documented above) available inside dedicated workers (WICG IDL exposure, fetched 2026-08-16).
